video_title: BLOCK PARTY LIVE PT. 1 🗽 Jose Alvarado, Mariska Join Jalen, Josh for Championship Celebration

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson confirms he is fully cleared after offseason surgery
quotes.excerpt: I had surgery this offseason and I wanted to tell you guys that I am fully cleared.
quotes.quote: As you guys know, I had surgery this offseason and I wanted to tell you guys that I am fully cleared.

quotes.speaker: Jose Alvarado
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado on the impact of Game 4 and his missed layup
quotes.excerpt: If we never won that Game 4 because that missed layup, he cannot be around here.
quotes.quote: First of all, let's remind him. If we never won that Game 4 because that missed layup, he cannot be around here. You know what I'm saying?

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his performance and mindset during Game 4
quotes.excerpt: I was just being confident and trusting my work and also just being ready for the moment.
quotes.quote: It was just a good combination of just being confident and trusting my work and also just being ready for the moment.

quotes.speaker: Jose Alvarado
quotes.summary_phrase: Jose Alvarado on his nerves and confidence during Game 5
quotes.excerpt: I was nervous a bunch of times, but that game I was never nervous.
quotes.quote: I've been nervous before a bunch of times, but that game I was never nervous. As soon as he called my name, I was like, finally, I'm going to get to play. I knew that lineup was coming. I know they only pay attention to him, so I knew I was going to get a few layups here and there.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his impact and decision-making during the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: He changed the game because he changed the pace, he was getting in the paint.
quotes.quote: I feel like he changed the game because he changed the pace, he was getting in the paint. When people were collapsing, he was kicking out and they didn't collapse. He was making smart basketball plays and he was making big shots. He was just ready to play. It's what it is. He wasn't scared of the moment.

quotes.speaker: Mariska Hargitay
quotes.summary_phrase: Mariska Hargitay praises Jalen Brunson's performance and professionalism
quotes.excerpt: He killed it and he did his close-up in one take.
quotes.quote: He killed it. He killed it. And he did his close-up in one take.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the importance of Mariska Hargitay's appearance
quotes.excerpt: I've been afraid to formally ask you to come on the show, just in case you were like no.
quotes.quote: I've been afraid to formally ask you to come on the show, just in case you were like no. I didn't want that rejection in my heart, so I just want to say thank you so much and I really do appreciate you.

quotes.speaker: Mariska Hargitay
quotes.summary_phrase: Mariska Hargitay on her emotional experience during the Knicks playoff run
quotes.excerpt: I was in such a another state. I was like the happiest moment of my life.
quotes.quote: I was in such a another state. I was like the happiest moment of my life. And I just felt like I was all of you. And it was the most insane. Something took over inside. I actually can't remember. It was like an out-of-body experience.

quotes.speaker: Mariska Hargitay
quotes.summary_phrase: Mariska Hargitay on her failed attempt to get Daniel Radcliffe on Law & Order
quotes.excerpt: I actually asked the theater if Daniel Radcliffe could fill in for me that night.
quotes.quote: I actually asked the theater if Daniel Radcliffe could fill in for me that night. And they said, Mariska, that's not how it works.

quotes.speaker: Mariska Hargitay
quotes.summary_phrase: Mariska Hargitay confirms the return of her Law & Order character
quotes.excerpt: I think you all know who's back. Yeah, I got my old partner back.
quotes.quote: I think you all know who's back. Yeah, I got my old partner back.

quotes.speaker: Landry Shamet
quotes.summary_phrase: Landry Shamet on the challenges of training camp and team adversity
quotes.excerpt: It was tough, getting hurt and kind of two years in a row training camp deal.
quotes.quote: It was tough, getting hurt and kind of two years in a row training camp deal. It was, you know, got thrown some adversity, but obviously it all panned out. And having good teammates like you guys and people who you know like believe in you, you know beyond just just relying on yourself.

quotes.speaker: Landry Shamet
quotes.summary_phrase: Landry Shamet on the team's commitment to picking up the slack
quotes.excerpt: We have that kind of commitment to each other to pick up the slack where we can.
quotes.quote: We have that kind of commitment to each other to pick up the slack where we can. So that's a team thing, that's it's special.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the unique team unity of the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: Every team I've been on, there's a point where ulterior motives and unity breaks.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: Every team I've been on, there's a point where ulterior motives and unity breaks, and I genuinely never felt that this year. There wasn't one point where we were like, we have our little run-ins and people butt heads, that's what teams are, but never truly underlying like, I'm kind of hoping things don't go well for him so I can, whatever. That never happened one time and that was special.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: What's the most annoying thing about being teammates with Josh Hart?

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart and Jalen Brunson discuss their on-court chemistry
quotes.excerpt: I feel like certain guys, if I've done well and I might be shooting myself in the foot.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: I feel like certain guys, if I've done well and I might be shooting myself in the foot here, but I feel like they don't really annoy me a whole lot. And that might just completely open a whole new can of worms. This year is going to be terrible for me, but I don't know. Josh doesn't get on my nerves.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: Jaylen says a couple things, I, hey, stop. We know. You asked me and I stopped.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: You asked me and I stopped. You're right. That sounds crazy now that I think about it.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart reflects on his role and sacrifice for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: This team I think is special because we're all willing to sacrifice.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: You saved my ass a lot this year, bro. And like you said, this team I think is special because we're all willing to sacrifice. And I truly think you're right in the middle of that, bro, because you've had amazing moments for us, you've won big games for us, but you also been willing to sacrifice. And I think I can sit here and say on behalf of all of New York, we're so happy that you resigned this year, man, and we appreciate you, dog.
